results.title: Teen boy from Ghana chased and fatally shot on way to school in New York City
results.snippet: Javits Frimpong, 15, was being bullied at school before he was shot and killed in the Bronx on Thursday, his father says.

results.snippet:
Frimpong's father said he brought his son from Ghana to live with him about a year ago in hopes of a better life. The teen's mother is trying to travel to New York to see her son's body.
